description.raw: Thane becomes invincible and unleashes 8 slashes on random enemies across the battlefield. Each slash deals 210% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage and applies a Sword Mark. After the final slash, he detonates all Sword Marks, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) true damage to enemies within 1 tiles. If an enemy takes damage from multiple Sword Mark detonations, subsequent hits deal 50% less damage. Each duel Thane successfully completes adds 2 slashes to this skill. After he completes 3 duels, his swordsmanship reaches perfection, and this skill counts as a normal attack.
active: Thane becomes invincible and unleashes 8 slashes on random enemies across the battlefield.
Each slash deals 210% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage and applies a Sword Mark.
After the final slash, he detonates all Sword Marks, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) true damage to enemies within 1 tiles.
If an enemy takes damage from multiple Sword Mark detonations, subsequent hits deal 50% less damage.
Each duel Thane successfully completes adds 2 slashes to this skill.
After he completes 3 duels, his swordsmanship reaches perfection, and this skill counts as a normal attack.

description.raw: After a battle starts, Thane blinks to the rearmost enemy hero in his column and challenges them to a duel. He then repeats this in the column to his left, followed by the column to his right. Each duel lasts for 4s. During the duel, both heroes prioritize attacking each other and can only use normal attacks. If Thane has at least 20% HP remaining when the duel ends, the duel is considered successfully completed, restoring 50% + 5% (SP-based) of Thane's max HP and permanently increasing his basic stats by 12% + 1.5% (SP-based). Thane remains unaffected during duels. After he completes 3 duels, his unaffected status lasts until the end of the battle.

After he completes 3 duels, his unaffected status lasts until the end of the battle.

text: Increases the damage dealt by phantom slashes to 180% (ATK-based).
